description.detail: The exporter writes nodes.tsv, edges.tsv, verdicts.tsv and graph.npz plus schema and README, reconciling emitted edges with verdict rows. Its first run pruned 1,015 edges, 1,014 of them associated_with under R09_invalid_probability (max_conf > 1) and one under R08_impossible_activity; that prune count was later corrected.
description.numbers: 9,512 nodes; 37,697 edges; 37,697 verdicts; keep 36,682; prune 1,015 (R09 1,014, R08 1); threshold 0.5
